news.title:
Action Construction Equipment Ltd's board approved transferring its Heavy Cranes Business to ACE KATO Pvt Ltd, a 50:50 JV with KATO Works Co. Ltd.
The transfer, valued at Rs 85.8 crore (FY25 revenue), will occur via a slump sale, with consideration in ACE subscription shares.
